fact: Presidential Decree 275/20 of 21 October 2020 requires private credit information bureaux to keep their primary data processing centres and replica sites inside national territory (replicas at least 30 km apart) and to obtain the Data Protection Agency's prior authorisation to use cloud storage; the Agency authorises the bureaux.
title: Decreto Presidencial n.º 275/20 de 21 de outubro
publisher: Presidente da República (Diário da República I Série n.º 168)
